name: Sealed Envelope
summary: In Stonetalon, Fizziks has sealed Venture Company secrets in the Sealed Envelope for Sputtervalve in Ratchet.

sections.title: Corporate Espionage
sections.body: Cast out of the Venture Company's logging operations in the Stonetalon Mountains, goblin engineer Fizziks smuggled away its secrets. Inside the envelope are company manuals, operating procedures, and technical plans. Among them are schematics for the Super Reaper 6000, a machine built for industrial clear-cutting.

sections.title: Delivery to Ratchet
sections.body: Fizziks sends the documents south to Sputtervalve, an engineer in Ratchet's neutral goblin port. The Steamwheedle Cartel's rivals have little love or trust for Fizziks. Yet the designs hold clear engineering value. They reveal the Venture Company's mechanical skill and give independent engineers a chance to use its advanced logging methods.

faq.q: What is inside the Sealed Envelope?
faq.answer: The Sealed Envelope holds Venture Company manuals, technical documents, and schematics for the Super Reaper 6000, a wood-clearing machine. Fizziks stole them when he left the company in haste.
Goblin engineer Fizziks prepared the envelope after the Venture Company cast him out of its logging operation in the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Who is intended to receive it?
faq.answer: The envelope is meant for Sputtervalve, a goblin tinkerer in Ratchet, the port town in the Barrens.

faq.q: Why does Sputtervalve want these documents?
faq.answer: Sputtervalve dislikes the Venture Company, and the documents offer valuable improvements and schematics. They let outside tinkerers understand and adopt its powerful mechanical designs.

angles.text: For an engineer, the envelope holds technical drawings for the Super Reaper 6000, a destructive and lucrative machine devised by goblins.
As a member of the Horde, carrying these papers south from Stonetalon helps Ratchet's neutral goblins undermine the Venture Company's aggressive, exploitative logging operations.
